name: Understand-Anything
description: Builds an explorable knowledge graph of a codebase with a multi-agent pipeline, then answers questions, maps diff impact, and writes onboarding guides inside coding agents.

skills.name: Build Knowledge Graph
skills.description: Scans a project and builds a graph of every file, function, class, and dependency, re-analyzing only changed files on later runs.

skills.name: Ask the Codebase
skills.description: Answers natural-language questions about the codebase using the generated knowledge graph.

skills.name: Diff Impact Analysis
skills.description: Shows which parts of the system your current changes affect before you commit.

skills.name: Onboarding Guide
skills.description: Generates an onboarding guide for new team members from the analyzed codebase.

skills.name: Domain Extraction
skills.description: Extracts business domains, flows, and steps and maps them to the code that implements them.
